author: Karl Rock
description:
Sting has become an absolute staple in India & Pakistan. It is incredibly popular, and you will find it everywhere from busy city streets to remote roadside stalls. At just Rs. 20 in India, it is a massive cultural phenomenon, offering a quick energy boost for a fraction of the cost you would pay for global brands like Red Bull.

The search for a cold bottle is a daily struggle though. Most of the refrigerators at these small shops are not actually powered on, leaving you to hope for the best.

Do you drink energy drinks like Sting?
title: India & Pakistan's #1 Energy Drink

author: Karl Rock
description:
Stepping into the ruins of Mohenjo-daro feels like walking through a ghost story. Located in modern day Pakistan, this was once a thriving metropolis of the Indus Valley Civilisation. It was incredibly advanced for its time, featuring sophisticated drainage systems, grid city planning, and complex brick architecture that still puzzles archaeologists today.

The most haunting part is the silence left behind. Thousands of people once walked these streets, trading goods and living daily lives, but then the city simply emptied. Historians still debate exactly why this civilisation collapsed, with theories ranging from climate change and shifting rivers to sudden disaster.

Walking through these ancient walls, the lack of answers is what makes it so captivating. It is a powerful reminder that even the greatest cities can vanish into the sands of time, leaving behind only questions for us to find.
title: Did you know about this lost city?
